Definition: Jozabad, the name of ten Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jozabad or Josabad = "Jehovah has endowed"; 1) a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David; 2) one of David's mighty warriors; 3) another of David's mighty warriors; 4) four other priests or Levites
